oos_threshold.criterion: F1 on the binary in-scope/out-of-scope decision, dev only (no intent prediction exists before the model call)

intent_descriptions.calendar_query: Requests to view, search, or check existing calendar events and schedules.
intent_descriptions.calendar_remove: Requests to cancel or delete an existing calendar event.
intent_descriptions.calendar_set: Requests to create or schedule a new calendar event or appointment.
intent_descriptions.email_addcontact: Requests to save a new person or email address as a contact.
intent_descriptions.email_query: Requests to search, find, or check emails in the mailbox.
intent_descriptions.email_querycontact: Requests to retrieve stored contact information about a person.
intent_descriptions.email_sendemail: Requests to compose and send an email to a recipient.
intent_descriptions.lists_createoradd: Requests to create a new list or add items to an existing list.
intent_descriptions.lists_query: Requests to view or check items in an existing list.
intent_descriptions.lists_remove: Requests to remove or delete items from an existing list.

entity_descriptions.business_name: Name of a business or organization explicitly mentioned in a calendar, email, or list request.
entity_descriptions.business_type: Category of a business mentioned in a request, such as a clinic or restaurant.
entity_descriptions.date: Calendar date, day, or relative date mentioned for an event or task.
entity_descriptions.email_address: Email address specified as a recipient or contact detail.
entity_descriptions.email_folder: Mailbox folder mentioned, such as inbox, sent, drafts, or spam.
entity_descriptions.event_name: Name or title of a calendar event, meeting, or appointment.
entity_descriptions.general_frequency: How often an event repeats, such as daily, weekly, or every Monday.
entity_descriptions.list_name: Name of the list to create, view, or modify.
entity_descriptions.person: Name or identifying reference of a person mentioned in a request.
entity_descriptions.personal_info: Type of contact information requested, such as phone number or email address.
entity_descriptions.place_name: Location or venue mentioned for an event, such as an office or meeting room.
entity_descriptions.relation: Relationship of a mentioned person to the user, such as manager, colleague, or mother.
entity_descriptions.time: Specific clock time mentioned for an event, such as 10 AM or 3:30 PM.
entity_descriptions.timeofday: Part of the day mentioned, such as morning, afternoon, or evening.

effort.note: active human minutes are self-reported and exclude breaks and model waiting time. Wall clock is elapsed time since `start`, which includes both.

ai_assistance: Used ChatGPT to recommend an initial configuration and draft and explain the intent and entity descriptions.
notes: Selected twostage-sim-llm because intent classification followed by field extraction may help preserve multiple details in complex productivity requests. Similar examples may improve recognition of varied wording, and LLM-based out-of-scope handling may recognize unsupported requests beyond lexical similarity. Trade-offs include two model calls, additional latency, and possible incorrect classifications. No development checks have been run yet. Active time estimated at 10-20 minutes; 15 recorded as the midpoint.
bias_note: the same person built the automated system and this manual baseline, and already knows the data. This is a single, non-blind measurement of setup effort and must be reported as such.
